name: Ray Marching Volume Rendering with Henyey-Greenstein Scattering
definition: A ray marching algorithm that renders a 3D volume defined by a density texture. It computes color by accumulating scattered light along a ray, using the Henyey-Greenstein phase function for anisotropic scattering and shadow rays for self-shadowing.
summary: Ray Marching Volume Rendering with Henyey-Greenstein Scattering renders 3D volumes by accumulating scattered light using the Henyey-Greenstein phase function to model anisotropic scattering and shadow rays for self-shadowing.
